scope: Development-host native C++ costs with synthetic poses and exact protocol receipts. These are not Windows presentation, Rapier-step, GPU-upload, or owner physical-acceptance budgets.
caveats: p99 and maximum include host scheduling delays; every observed maximum is retained.
A percentile with fewer than 1000 steady-state samples is descriptive, not final budget qualification.
Construction and promotion samples are reported separately and are not silently mixed into steady-state percentiles.
Requested C++ allocation bytes are not RSS and exclude malloc metadata, C allocations, stacks and executable mappings.

Initial native storage counters reported 1.83 MB for three trees while global C++ new observed 4.23 MB. World non-cell metadata and other allocations are not included in the former; do not label resident_cell_bytes as total World residency.
The miniature-World experiment excludes common external World/physics/render work and qualifies only its declared equivalent-output material-domain fixture.
